title: Register every MCP server you declare
why: A server in .mcp.json with no entry anywhere is a tool your agents can reach that nobody recorded a decision about. Doorman grades servers precisely so this entry can cite a measurement instead of a memory, and an ungraded server is not an unsafe one, it is an unknown one.
fix: Add a registry table to .claude/rules/ listing every server in .mcp.json with a status and a date. Run doorman report <url>, which is free and needs no key, and put the grade in the row.
